subject: General Aptitude
question: A man covers a distance of 240 km at a speed of 60 km/h for the first half and 40 km/h for the second half. What is the average speed for the whole journey? (in km/h)
solution: Half distance = 120 km. Time first half = 120/60 = 2 h, second half = 120/40 = 3 h. Total time = 5 h. Average = 240/5 = 48 km/h.
